hunks.baseline: The atmosphere grew worse by the second.
hunks.sol: The atmosphere went from bad to worse.

hunks.baseline: “The important fact is that the duel was fair!”
hunks.sol: “The important thing is that the duel was fair!”

hunks.baseline: “Fair? Since when is using poison considered fair? Is this the Sichuan Tang Clan or something?”
hunks.sol: “Fair? Since when is using poison considered fair? What is this, the Sichuan Tang Clan?”

hunks.baseline: “The man himself said he didn’t do it! And as the Medicine King Hall Leader said earlier, Lee Seogeun was perfectly fine—”
hunks.sol: “He says he didn’t do it! And as the Medicine King Hall Leader said earlier, Lee Seogeun was perfectly fine—”

hunks.baseline: “Of course the Third Young Master would say he didn’t. And how can you believe that quack?”
hunks.sol: “Of course the Third Young Master would deny it. And how can you trust that quack?”

hunks.baseline: “A quack? You little bastard!”
hunks.sol: “A quack? You bastard!”

hunks.baseline: “If necessary, we should stop the war even if it means offering up the Third Young Master’s head!”
hunks.sol: “If necessary, we should prevent the war even if it means offering up the Third Young Master’s head!”

hunks.baseline: “What kind of outrageous nonsense is that?”
hunks.sol: “What outrageous nonsense!”

hunks.baseline: “Am I wrong? Let’s just admit it. The Mount Heng Sword Sect is stronger than our family. If war begins, hundreds will die or be injured, and in the worst case, our family could be destroyed. If we hand over the Third Young Master, who caused all this, won’t everything be over?”
hunks.sol: “Am I wrong? It’s time we admitted the truth. The Mount Heng Sword Sect is stronger than our family. If war breaks out, hundreds will be killed or injured. At worst, our family could be destroyed. All this would end if we handed over the Third Young Master, the cause of the entire crisis!”

hunks.baseline: What kind of bullshit was that? I hadn’t heard such spectacular nonsense in a long time. The back of my neck tightened, and my chest grew tight.
hunks.sol: Was that supposed to be an argument, or a fart? It had been a while since I’d heard such spectacular bullshit. The back of my neck tightened, and my chest began to ache.

hunks.baseline: His voice was quiet, but it carried power. In fact, its quietness made it sound even clearer.
hunks.sol: The voice was quiet, but it carried power. If anything, its quietness made every word clearer.

hunks.baseline: It was Jin Wikyung. He looked around the room with an expressionless face.
hunks.sol: It was Jin Wikyung. He surveyed the room, his face expressionless.

hunks.baseline: “Whose. Head. Did you say we’d offer?”
hunks.sol: “Whose. Head. Did you say we should offer?”

hunks.baseline: Each syllable fell separately, frost coating his voice. The atmosphere was so chilling that even I shivered.
hunks.sol: Each syllable fell separately, his voice rimed with frost. The air turned so chilling that even I shivered.

hunks.baseline: The White Tiger Hall Leader spoke up at once.
hunks.sol: The White Tiger Hall Leader immediately opened his mouth.

hunks.baseline: “Obviously, the Third Young Master, the main culprit behind this—ah.”
hunks.sol: “Why, obviously the Third Young Master, the main culprit behind this—ah.”

hunks.baseline: That bastard was bald, and he couldn’t read the room either. The White Tiger Hall Leader let his words trail off, but it was already too late.
hunks.sol: The bastard had no hair and no tact. The White Tiger Hall Leader trailed off, but it was already too late.

hunks.baseline: “So you intend to hand the Third Young Master’s head over to the Mount Heng Sword Sect over something that has not even been confirmed? Is that something a hall leader of this family should be saying?”
hunks.sol: “So you intend to hand the Third Young Master’s head over to the Mount Heng Sword Sect because of an unconfirmed accusation? Is that something a hall leader of this family should say?”

hunks.baseline: “No, that’s not what I meant…”
hunks.sol: “No, that isn’t what I meant…”

hunks.baseline: The White Tiger Hall Leader was overwhelmed by Jin Wikyung’s aura and avoided his eyes. Jin Wikyung silently glared at him.
hunks.sol: Overwhelmed by Jin Wikyung’s aura, the White Tiger Hall Leader avoided his gaze. Jin Wikyung silently glared at him.

hunks.baseline: He wasn’t normally like this, which made him even scarier now that he was angry.
hunks.sol: A man who rarely got angry was all the more frightening when he did.

hunks.baseline: Looking at the White Tiger Hall Leader’s pale face made me feel as if ten years of indigestion had finally been cured. Jin Wikyung rose from his seat and looked down at everyone with a cold expression.
hunks.sol: The sight of the White Tiger Hall Leader’s deathly pale face felt like a ten-year bout of indigestion finally clearing up. Jin Wikyung rose and looked coldly down at everyone present.

hunks.baseline: “You all already know.”
hunks.sol: “You already know the truth.”

hunks.baseline: He looked around the room and spoke firmly.
hunks.sol: He swept his gaze across the room and spoke firmly.

hunks.baseline: “That the duel was fair, and Lee Seogeun’s poisoning was a conspiracy. Knowing that, are you suggesting we submit to them out of fear?”
hunks.sol: “You know the duel was fair and that Lee Seogeun’s poisoning was a conspiracy. Yet despite knowing that, you would have us submit to them out of fear?”

hunks.baseline: The members of the Elder Council faction avoided his gaze. Jin Wikyung’s sneer grew deeper.
hunks.sol: The members of the Elder Council faction avoided his gaze. Jin Wikyung’s sneer sharpened.

hunks.baseline: “I don’t know who placed it in their hands, but the Mount Heng Sword Sect holds the hilt of a sword called justification. Whether it happens today or tomorrow—or whether the sword has already been drawn—we are already too late to reverse it. There is only one way forward. We fight.”
hunks.sol: “I don’t know who placed it in their hands, but the Mount Heng Sword Sect now holds the hilt of a sword called justification. Whether they draw it today or tomorrow—or whether it has already been drawn—it is too late for us to turn things back. Only one path remains. We fight.”

hunks.baseline: “Do you want to live? Do you want to protect the family? If you truly do, prepare the martial artists and prepare for war. Or cut off my head and my younger brother’s, then offer them to the Mount Heng Sword Sect. If all you want is wealth and glory, I suppose that isn’t a bad option, either.”
hunks.sol: “Do you want to live? Do you want to protect the family? If you truly do, ready the martial artists and prepare for war. Otherwise, cut off my younger brother’s head and mine and offer them up. If wealth and glory are all you desire, I suppose that would not be a bad choice.”

hunks.sol: A suffocating silence seized the main assembly hall.

hunks.sol: If one man had not spoken the next moment, that silence might have crushed us for hours.

hunks.baseline: It was the man who had watched the situation without saying a word until now.
hunks.sol: It was the man who had watched the entire affair without saying a word.

hunks.baseline: A person to watch out for. The family’s highest-ranking elder and the head of the Elder Council.
hunks.sol: Someone I needed to watch. The family’s most senior elder and the leader of the Elder Council.

hunks.baseline: I remembered the Sound Transmission Jin Wikyung had sent me earlier.
hunks.sol: I recalled Jin Wikyung’s earlier Sound Transmission.

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung was the greatest ally and adviser I had among the NPCs.

hunks.baseline: And I reached one conclusion.
hunks.sol: And I’d reached one conclusion.

hunks.sol: If someone asked how many NPCs I’d encountered since starting this godforsaken game, the number would easily exceed a hundred.

hunks.sol: *I can’t read him.*

hunks.sol: When the interrogation began. When the senior members of each faction shouted at one another. Even now.

hunks.baseline: The Head Elder’s vigorous applause rang through the hall.
hunks.sol: The Head Elder’s vigorous applause echoed through the hall.

hunks.baseline: “I thought of you as nothing more than a youngster, but before I knew it, the Lesser Family Head had become such a dignified martial artist. Excellent. That is how the Lesser Family Head of our family should be.”
hunks.sol: “I thought you still a mere youngster, but before I knew it, the Lesser Family Head had become such a dignified martial artist. Excellent. That is how the Lesser Family Head of our family should conduct himself.”

hunks.baseline: “Excessive humility can look like arrogance. You have nothing to apologize for.”
hunks.sol: “Excessive humility can appear arrogant. You have nothing to apologize for.”

hunks.baseline: “May this old man add a word? What do you think, Lesser Family Head?”
hunks.sol: “May this old man add a few words? What do you say, Lesser Family Head?”

hunks.baseline: “I will take it to heart.”
hunks.sol: “I will heed them.”

hunks.baseline: The Head Elder slowly rose from his seat, and dozens of pairs of eyes locked onto him.
hunks.sol: As the Head Elder slowly rose, dozens of pairs of eyes fixed on him.

hunks.baseline: He was the family’s highest-ranking elder. In terms of authority and standing within the family, he might even surpass Jin Wikyung.
hunks.sol: He was the family’s most senior elder. In terms of authority and standing within the family, he might even surpass Jin Wikyung.

hunks.baseline: The biggest problem was that he was the head of the opposing faction—the Elder Council.
hunks.sol: The biggest problem was that he led the opposing faction—the Elder Council.

hunks.baseline: *Fuck, I’m screwed.*
hunks.sol: *Fuck. I’m screwed.*

hunks.baseline: Preparing for the worst, I started edging toward the door when the Head Elder’s first words reached my ears.
hunks.sol: Preparing for the worst, I began edging toward the door. Then the Head Elder’s first words reached my ears.

hunks.baseline: But I hadn’t.
hunks.sol: I hadn’t.

hunks.baseline: “Even beasts join forces and fight when an enemy enters their den. And yet men who are supposedly senior members of this family offer up the head of a direct-line member as a solution to stop a war. Heh. So men like this sit in our family council.”
hunks.sol: “Even beasts join forces when an enemy enters their den. Yet men who call themselves senior members of this family propose offering up the head of a direct-line member to prevent a war. Heh. To think men like you sit on our family council.”

hunks.baseline: “N-no, Head Elder. You’ve misunderstood. It was merely…”
hunks.sol: “H-Head Elder, you misunderstand. We merely…”

hunks.baseline: At the Head Elder’s chilly call, the White Tiger Hall Leader stiffened.
hunks.sol: The White Tiger Hall Leader stiffened at the Head Elder’s chilly call.

hunks.baseline: “Have I been away for too long? Or is it because the Family Head is absent?”
hunks.sol: “Was I away for too long? Or did this happen because the Family Head was absent?”

hunks.baseline: Going by the Head Elder’s expression, he looked like a muscular old man at a gym asking whether you’d eaten. But the content of his words was vicious beyond belief.
hunks.sol: Judging by his expression alone, he looked like some muscular old guy at the gym casually asking whether you’d eaten. The words coming out of his mouth, however, were downright vicious.

hunks.baseline: What was going on? Why was he taking our side?
hunks.sol: What the hell was going on? Why was he taking our side?

hunks.baseline: I looked around frantically, but everyone else was just as confused as I was. Both factions were visibly flustered.
hunks.sol: I looked around frantically, but everyone else seemed just as confused as I was. Both factions were visibly flustered.

hunks.baseline: “If war has become inevitable, then our first priority should be to discipline those within our ranks. Wouldn’t it be best to cut off the heads of those men who are little different from rebels?”
hunks.sol: “If war is now inevitable, our first priority should be putting our own house in order. Should we not begin by cutting off the heads of those men who are little better than traitors?”

hunks.baseline: In the frozen air, Jin Wikyung stared at the Head Elder for a long moment before answering in something like a sigh.
hunks.sol: In the frozen silence, Jin Wikyung stared at the Head Elder for a long moment before forcing out an answer like a sigh.
Whew.

hunks.sol: The White Tiger Hall Leader sighed in relief.

hunks.baseline: Considering how he had just been talking about offering up my head, I was a little disappointed.
hunks.sol: Considering that he had just suggested offering up my head, I was a little disappointed.

hunks.baseline: *Should I suggest that we kill just him?*
hunks.sol: *Should I suggest killing just him?*

hunks.sol: “Those men were not content merely to frame a direct-line member of the family. They even argued that we should surrender him to the enemy. Do you not think your response is too lenient?”

hunks.sol: “They have served our family faithfully for many years. I will consider their words an ill-considered remark made in the heat of the moment.”

hunks.sol: “An ill-considered remark. An ill-considered remark, indeed. Yes, the Lesser Family Head’s capacity is greater than I imagined. You are truly worthy of your position. hunks.sol: An inexplicable sense of wrongness swept over me. I hurriedly examined the people gathered around the Head Elder.

hunks.sol: And then I saw them.

hunks.sol: The faint smiles passing over the lips of the Elder Council members who had cornered me earlier.

hunks.baseline: Was this all planned? Every bit of it?
hunks.sol: Had all of this been planned? Every last bit of it?
